note: Commerce Currency Resolver enhances Commerce 3 multi-currency. Config object commerce_currency_resolver.settings has currency_source (field|auto|combo), currency_field_prefix (default field_price_), currency_exchange_rates. Price resolver commerce_currency_resolver.price_resolver returns the {prefix}{code} per-currency field (e.g. field_price_eur) when the resolved currency differs; order processor + order-load subscriber refresh draft, unlocked, current-user-owned orders on currency mismatch. currency_resolver cache context. Config UI at /admin/commerce/config/commerce_currency_resolver/settings, permission 'administer commerce currency resolver settings'. Medium reads back a known settings value; hard writes a settings value verified from live config. All eval cases operate on config only (site has only USD + no store, so no runtime conversion is exercised). Scripts stash the live baseline and restore it.

evals.prompt: In Drupal Commerce, what does the Commerce Currency Resolver module do, at what admin path is it configured, and which permission controls that configuration?
evals.expected_output: It enhances Commerce 3 multi-currency by resolving the visitor's currency and returning/converting per-currency prices. Configured at /admin/commerce/config/commerce_currency_resolver/settings, gated by the 'administer commerce currency resolver settings' permission.

evals.prompt: Which values can the currency_source setting of Commerce Currency Resolver take, and what does each mean?
evals.expected_output: field = per-currency price fields only; auto = convert everything via Commerce Exchanger; combo = use a per-currency field if present, otherwise auto-convert.

evals.prompt: When Commerce Currency Resolver uses per-currency price fields, how is the field name for a given currency built, and what is the default prefix?
evals.expected_output: The field name is {currency_field_prefix}{lowercase currency code}. The default prefix is field_price_, so the Euro field is field_price_eur.

evals.prompt: On this Drupal site, which pricing strategy is Commerce Currency Resolver configured to use (the currency_source setting)? Inspect the live configuration.
evals.expected_output: The commerce_currency_resolver.settings currency_source is set to 'auto' (convert everything via Commerce Exchanger).

evals.prompt: On this Drupal site, what currency field prefix has Commerce Currency Resolver been configured with (the prefix used to build per-currency price fields)? Inspect the live configuration.

On this Drupal site, configure Commerce Currency Resolver to use the 'combo' pricing strategy (use a per-currency price field if present, otherwise auto-convert). Apply the change to the live configuration.
evals.expected_output: Set commerce_currency_resolver.settings currency_source to 'combo' (e.g. `drush cset -y commerce_currency_resolver.settings currency_source combo`).

evals.prompt: On this Drupal site, change Commerce Currency Resolver's per-currency price field prefix to 'field_money_'. Apply the change to the live configuration.
evals.expected_output: Set commerce_currency_resolver.settings currency_field_prefix to 'field_money_' (e.g. `drush cset -y commerce_currency_resolver.settings currency_field_prefix field_money_`).
